assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one opaque 4:3 pixel art background for Android life game event adult_001, "University or employment". Create one coherent scene, NOT UI or collage.
Scene: first-person young adult sitting at their wooden desk in a modest Korean home bedroom, pondering TWO simultaneous acceptance messages on ONE smartphone. The phone must show two clearly separate large nonverbal message cards: a university/building-and-graduation-cap icon on one, a briefcase/company-building icon on the other; equal importance, neither selected. Below them a smaller family group-chat notification with several anonymous round icons and opposing reply blocks, WITHOUT text or numbers. Young adult gender-neutral hands naturally hold the phone; no face or reflection. Quiet neutral indoor lighting; time of day unspecified. Family appears only via group-chat symbols, nobody else physically present.
Composition: landscape 4:3 image but keep ENTIRE phone, all three notification groups and both holding hands compactly stacked inside the middle 32 percent of image width so they survive a very narrow portrait CENTER CROP (33.1–66.9% of source width). Phone center at x=50%, top 25%, bottom 75%; desk and bedroom extend to sides as atmosphere. Phone screen large and easily distinguishable icons, not tiny microtext. Natural first person eye level looking slightly downward.
Style: crisp medium-density 16-bit pixel art, visible consistent square pixel grid, flat limited color steps, warm muted cream/ochre/wood brown, olive and dusty blue/teal; clear object silhouettes, restrained highlights, like cozy narrative life-simulation game backgrounds.
Avoid all readable letters/numerals/pseudo-writing/logos/watermarks/game interface, health bars, buttons, cinematic frames, faces, graduation ceremony, signed contract, office work, career chosen, victory celebration, split screen, blur, gradients, dithering, photorealism, 3D. This is BEFORE any choice; show only the competing notifications and contemplation. Save an actual PNG image and return its local file path.
